meta.title: Cardano Developer Tooling Map
meta.note: Status and stars are a research-time snapshot and drift over time.
meta.communitySource: State of the Developer Ecosystem 2025 (Cardano Foundation), n=109
meta.contactsNote: teamGithub / teamX are the GitHub org and verified X/Twitter handle for each node's team. The top-level `teams` map holds, per team, its githubOrg, x, and top human maintainers (login + x) to @-mention (GitHub @org does not notify).

nodes.name: Plutus / Plutus Core
nodes.description: Cardano's native on-chain platform. Plutus Core is the UPLC scripting language embedded in the ledger; the reference implementation all validators ultimately compile to.
nodes.featuresText: UPLC compiler, mechanized metatheory, EUTxO multi-asset support, Plutus Pioneer Program
nodes.usedBy: Foundation for the entire smart-contract stack; every on-chain script

nodes.name: Plinth (Plutus Tx)
nodes.description: The Haskell subset (renamed from Plutus Tx in 2025) that compiles to UPLC. Emphasizes type-safe, deterministic contracts with formal-verification hooks.
nodes.featuresText: Haskell-subset DSL, SMT/Lean verification integration, script-efficiency work
nodes.usedBy: Reference contracts; Midnight–Cardano bridge; verification research

nodes.name: Aiken
nodes.description: Purpose-built modern smart-contract language and toolchain compiling to UPLC. The de-facto choice for new projects thanks to strong DX, fast compiles and built-in testing.
nodes.featuresText: Static types, built-in unit + property tests, cost reporting, playground, great errors
nodes.usedBy: Minswap V2, LenFi, JPG Store, Indigo, Encoins

nodes.name: Plutarch
nodes.description: Typed Haskell eDSL giving fine-grained control over generated UPLC — validators are often far cheaper than Plutus Tx (reported ~74% CPU / ~78% mem reductions).
nodes.featuresText: Typed eDSL, aggressive optimization, plutarch-ledger-api/testlib packages
nodes.usedBy: Minswap, Liqwid, various MLabs / DeFi validators

nodes.name: Helios
nodes.description: Non-Haskell functional DSL with curly-brace syntax, shipped as a single dependency-free JS file so the compiler is easy to audit. Bundles a transaction library.
nodes.featuresText: Single-file compiler, JS/TS library, online playground, VSCode plugin

nodes.name: plu-ts
nodes.description: TypeScript eDSL for on-chain validators bundled with an off-chain transaction builder — write contracts in 100% valid TypeScript with full JS tooling.
nodes.featuresText: On-chain + off-chain in one lib, IDE/linter/debugger support, starter kit

nodes.name: Pebble
nodes.description: Strongly-typed, statement-oriented smart-contract language (let/if/while/match) that feels imperative but compiles to UPLC. A portal 'maintainer pick'.
nodes.featuresText: Familiar imperative syntax, dedicated parser/type-checker/compiler, FV roadmap

nodes.name: OpShin
nodes.description: Smart-contract language written as a strict subset of valid Python 3 — contracts run identically in Python and on-chain, unlocking the full Python tool ecosystem.
nodes.featuresText: 100% valid Python, static typing, Hypothesis property tests, pycardano artifacts

nodes.name: Scalus
nodes.description: Write on-chain and off-chain code in Scala 3, compiling a Scala subset to Plutus Core with a UPLC optimizer, VM interpreter, emulator and tx builder.
nodes.featuresText: Plutus V1/V2/V3, JVM+JS+native, emulator, HD wallet, Bloxbean integration

nodes.name: Marlowe
nodes.description: Domain-specific language for financial contracts, now community-maintained (CIC) after IOG stewardship. Contracts written in the language of finance with a visual designer.
nodes.featuresText: Visual designer, JS/TS/Haskell bindings, Marlowe Runtime, static analysis, ACTUS

nodes.name: Pluto
nodes.description: Human-friendly UPLC assembler for hand-writing/optimizing Untyped Plutus Core directly. Explicitly experimental and largely untested.
nodes.featuresText: Readable UPLC syntax, assemble/run commands, Haskell FFI

nodes.name: Plutonomy
nodes.description: A UPLC optimizer that plugs into any Plutus compilation pipeline as an extra pass to shrink script size and execution cost; semantics-preserving at default level.
nodes.featuresText: Configurable optimization levels, optimizeUPLC entrypoints, Minswap fork
nodes.usedBy: DeFi projects trimming script costs; ImperatorLang

nodes.name: Gastronomy
nodes.description: A time-travelling UPLC debugger that steps forward and backward through script execution, with source maps mapping bytecode back to Aiken source.
nodes.featuresText: Step fwd/back, machine-state inspection, Aiken source maps, CLI + app

nodes.name: plutus-halo2-verifier-gen
nodes.description: Generates on-chain Plinth/Aiken verifiers from Rust Halo2 zero-knowledge circuits so ZK proofs can be validated inside Cardano validators.
nodes.featuresText: ATMS circuits, verification-key extraction, on-chain proof verification

nodes.name: gnark-cardano
nodes.description: Pipeline for writing Groth16 ZK circuits in Go with gnark and verifying their proofs on-chain via a generic Aiken verifier.
nodes.featuresText: Groth16 circuits, Aiken verifier generation, on-chain verification
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: Cardinal
nodes.description: Protocol for wrapping Bitcoin UTxOs onto Cardano (Ordinals as NFTs) using BitVMX for decentralized, bridgeless BTC↔Cardano asset movement.
nodes.featuresText: BitVMX off-chain compute, Ordinals-as-NFTs, no custodians, ZK verification

nodes.name: Hebi
nodes.description: Compiler using a very restricted Python subset for ultra-small on-chain scripts. Archived April 2024; its gains were folded into OpShin.
nodes.featuresText: Restricted Python subset, minimal script size (superseded)

nodes.name: plutus-simple-model
nodes.description: Lightweight mock-blockchain unit-testing library for Plutus with resource estimation. Archived Jan 2025; successor is the CLB emulator.
nodes.featuresText: Minimal deps, accurate UTxO model, resource estimation (read-only now)

nodes.name: Lucid Evolution
nodes.description: Production-grade, actively-maintained successor to Lucid: a scalable TypeScript transaction builder and off-chain framework for dApps.
nodes.featuresText: Type-safe API, 12+ modular packages, DI, hardfork-ready, multi-provider
nodes.usedBy: Midgard, many new dApps (recommended over Lucid)

nodes.name: Lucid
nodes.description: The original TypeScript tx-builder / off-chain library. Widely used historically but largely superseded by Lucid Evolution.
nodes.featuresText: Tx balancing, Plutus blueprint (CIP-57), multi-provider, Deno/Node/browser
nodes.usedBy: Minswap (via custom SDK), DripDropz, legacy dApps

nodes.name: MeshJS (Mesh SDK)
nodes.description: All-in-one TypeScript SDK: transaction builder, wallet connectors, React components, providers and contract templates. 1M+ npm downloads.
nodes.featuresText: Tx builder, CIP-30 wallet UI, React hooks, multi-provider, contract templates

nodes.name: cardano-serialization-lib (CSL)
nodes.description: Low-level Rust library (with WASM/JS bindings) for serializing and deserializing Cardano's core data structures. A foundation under many higher-level SDKs.
nodes.featuresText: CDDL-driven codegen, browser/Node/asm.js builds, GC support, type defs

nodes.name: cardano-multiplatform-lib (CML)
nodes.description: Rust serialization + tx-building library with WASM bindings for browser, Node, mobile and native — a dApp/wallet-oriented CSL alternative.
nodes.featuresText: Tx builder, certs/metadata/minting, treasury donation, multiplatform packages
nodes.usedBy: Lucid Evolution, Flint, dApps needing low-level control

nodes.name: PyCardano
nodes.description: Lightweight pure-Python library to build and sign transactions with no cardano-cli or CSL dependency; a portal 'maintainer pick'.
nodes.featuresText: Pure Python, high-level builder + raw txns, Plutus support
nodes.usedBy: Python dApps, backends, OpShin off-chain, data science

nodes.name: Blaze
nodes.description: Clean, procedural TypeScript transaction library oriented toward Aiken contracts and DeFi DX; includes a pure-TS UPLC parser and CEK machine.
nodes.featuresText: Built on cardano-js-sdk types, PlutusV3 CEK, emulator, pretty printer

nodes.name: cardano-transaction-lib (CTL)
nodes.description: PureScript framework for building smart-contract transactions in browser/Node, porting Plutus off-chain patterns to a strongly-typed functional stack.
nodes.featuresText: PureScript types, Ogmios+Kupo or Blockfrost backends, Plutip testing, SECP256k1

nodes.name: Atlas
nodes.description: Haskell application backend for Plutus off-chain code: intuitive tx building, UTxO balancing and script interaction with multiple data providers.
nodes.featuresText: Reference inputs/inline datums/ref scripts, Maestro/node/db-sync providers, test harness
nodes.usedBy: Genius Yield protocol; Haskell dApp teams

nodes.name: Kuber
nodes.description: Haskell library + JSON/REST API for composing balanced Cardano transactions, with first-class Hydra lifecycle support.
nodes.featuresText: JSON tx builder, multi-sig, Plutus/collateral, Hydra init/commit/close, Docker

nodes.name: Evolution SDK
nodes.description: Pure-TypeScript, WASM-free tx framework modeling transactions as typed declarative programs. First project in Intersect's incubation program.
nodes.featuresText: No WASM/native, static type inference, data schemas, Conway/staking, multi-provider

nodes.name: cardano-js-sdk
nodes.description: IOG's TypeScript SDK for wallet platforms: key management, hardware-wallet support, tx building and providers. Underpins Lace and other tools.
nodes.featuresText: Key management, HW wallet support, providers, tx building
nodes.usedBy: Lace; Evolution SDK / Blaze build on its types

nodes.name: Bloxbean Cardano Client Library
nodes.description: Comprehensive Java library for building Cardano transactions with HD wallets, Plutus support and pluggable backends.
nodes.featuresText: QuickTx + composable APIs, BIP32/39/CIP1852, governance API, multi-backend

nodes.name: Pallas
nodes.description: Rust-native building blocks for Cardano — serialization, crypto, multi-era ledger primitives and Ouroboros networking. Foundation for many Rust tools.
nodes.featuresText: P2P networking, ledger primitives, CBOR codec, tx builder, address codec

nodes.name: whisky
nodes.description: Rust SDK for building Cardano transactions with pluggable CSL or Pallas serialization backends.
nodes.featuresText: Tx building, CSL/Pallas backends, Rust-first

nodes.name: Cardano-C
nodes.description: MISRA-compliant C library for serializing Cardano data structures and building transactions — designed to be easy to bind from other languages.
nodes.featuresText: Serialization, tx building, MISRA compliance, binding-friendly

nodes.name: Cometa.js
nodes.description: JavaScript/TypeScript transaction-building toolkit backed by the native Cardano-C library.
nodes.featuresText: Tx building, backed by Cardano-C, JS/TS API

nodes.name: Apollo
nodes.description: Pure-Go library for Cardano serialization and transaction building.
nodes.featuresText: Pure Go, serialization, tx builder

nodes.name: Elm Cardano
nodes.description: Elm off-chain package for Cardano, designed to pair with Aiken for on-chain code.
nodes.featuresText: Off-chain in Elm, Aiken pairing

nodes.name: Typhonjs
nodes.description: Pure-JavaScript library for Cardano address generation and transaction building (powers Typhon wallet).
nodes.featuresText: Address gen, tx building, pure JS

nodes.name: cardano-web3-js
nodes.description: TypeScript SDK providing unified abstractions over CML, UPLC and Plutus-data libraries for Node and browser.
nodes.featuresText: Abstractions over CML/MSL/UPLC, tx + contract helpers, MIT

nodes.name: cardanocli-js
nodes.description: JavaScript/TypeScript wrapper around cardano-cli for scripting node interaction from JS environments.
nodes.featuresText: CLI bindings, key gen, tx build/submit, HD wallet

nodes.name: Tx3
nodes.description: Declarative DSL for describing UTxO transactions as reusable templates, with typed client generation for TS, Rust, Go and Python (and AI/MCP tooling).
nodes.featuresText: Tx templates, multi-language codegen, MCP tools, tx3.land registry
nodes.usedBy: Strike Finance, Indigo, VyFinance, Bodega, Fluid Tokens

nodes.name: CardanoKit
nodes.description: Swift library for building Cardano wallets and signing transactions in iOS/macOS apps, with HD wallet and address support.
nodes.featuresText: Bech32/hex addresses, HD wallet, Secure Enclave, built on CSL bridge

nodes.name: hydra-sdk
nodes.description: TypeScript SDK for building wallet apps on Hydra: Head lifecycle management and in-Head transaction building, with WASM bindings for browser and Node.
nodes.featuresText: Head lifecycle, in-Head tx building, WASM bindings
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: cardano-addresses
nodes.description: Library + CLI for mnemonics, HD key derivation and address construction; compiles to WASM for browser use.
nodes.featuresText: Mnemonic/seed, HD derivation, address inspection, WASM build
nodes.usedBy: Wallets, browser key management, seed tools

nodes.name: bech32
nodes.description: Haskell library and CLI for Bech32 address encoding/decoding (CIP-5/CIP-19).
nodes.featuresText: Bech32 encode/decode, CLI

nodes.name: Blockfrost
nodes.description: The most widely used hosted REST API for reading the chain and submitting transactions, with an IPFS gateway and a run-your-own backend option.
nodes.featuresText: REST for mainnet/testnets, IPFS, webhooks, SDKs in 15+ languages, free tier
nodes.usedBy: Wallets, dApps, exchanges across the ecosystem

nodes.name: Koios
nodes.description: Decentralized, community-run REST query layer served by a cluster of elastic nodes — no single point of failure, self-hostable.
nodes.featuresText: PostgREST filtering/paging, redundant endpoints, CLI + multi-language clients

nodes.name: Maestro
nodes.description: Hosted Web3 stack for UTxO chains: indexing, transaction management ('Turbo Transactions') and DeFi market data.
nodes.featuresText: Indexer API, Turbo Tx, token/asset metadata, DeFi data, rollback notifications

nodes.name: Anvil
nodes.description: Hosted REST API focused on building, signing and submitting transactions and minting assets across all Cardano networks.
nodes.featuresText: Tx build/sign/submit, minting, flexible UTxO sourcing, all networks
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: NOWNodes
nodes.description: Blockchain-as-a-service exposing Blockfrost-compatible REST, Rosetta and Ogmios WebSocket endpoints with shared/dedicated nodes.
nodes.featuresText: Blockfrost-compatible, Rosetta, Ogmios WS, 99.95% SLA
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: TangoCrypto
nodes.description: Enterprise REST API over HTTPS for transactions, payments and pool/block data with webhook notifications.
nodes.featuresText: REST, webhooks, payment/mint tracking, enterprise SLA

nodes.name: GetBlock
nodes.description: Ready-made Cardano node endpoints via dashboard, including a Rosetta implementation; shared or dedicated.
nodes.featuresText: Rosetta endpoints, RPC config, dashboard
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: NFTCDN
nodes.description: Content-delivery network for rendering Cardano NFT and token media in apps and websites.
nodes.featuresText: NFT/token media CDN, image resizing
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: Cardano on BigQuery
nodes.description: Full mainnet dataset on Google BigQuery, updated hourly and verified each epoch, queryable with standard SQL.
nodes.featuresText: Hourly updates, epoch verification, standard SQL
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: Dandelion APIs
nodes.description: Community suite of free APIs (Explorer, Submit, GraphQL, Ogmios, PostgREST, Koios) with a self-hostable 'Dandelion Lite' devnet.
nodes.featuresText: Multiple endpoint types, Blockfrost-compatible, Docker/K8s templates

nodes.name: cardano-db-sync
nodes.description: The foundational indexer: follows the chain and stores all on-chain data in a structured PostgreSQL database for SQL querying.
nodes.featuresText: Full history in Postgres, ledger state, asset tracking, Docker

nodes.name: cardano-graphql
nodes.description: Typed GraphQL API layer over db-sync data, with TypeScript codegen and transaction-submission mutations.
nodes.featuresText: Typed schema, TS client gen, Token Registry V2 (CIP-68), Hasura, Docker stack

nodes.name: Kupo
nodes.description: Lightweight, fast chain-index that tracks only outputs matching configured patterns, served over HTTP/JSON in constant memory. Portal 'maintainer pick'.
nodes.featuresText: Pattern matching (addr/policy/output ref), constant memory, ~100x faster for lookups
nodes.usedBy: Wallets, NFT platforms, CTL backends, Demeter

nodes.name: Oura
nodes.description: 'The tail of Cardano' — a Rust streaming pipeline that tails a node and forwards matching chain events to sinks like Kafka, Redis or webhooks.
nodes.featuresText: Source/filter/sink stages, watch/daemon modes, tiny footprint (runs on a Pi)
nodes.usedBy: Data pipelines, webhook automation, stream processing

nodes.name: Carp
nodes.description: Modular high-performance Rust indexer syncing selected data into PostgreSQL — a faster, lighter db-sync alternative.
nodes.featuresText: Modular schema, selective sync, raw CBOR storage, sub-10ms address history
nodes.usedBy: Wallets, analytics needing fast focused data

nodes.name: Dolos
nodes.description: Lightweight Rust data node that follows the chain and serves queries over REST, gRPC and node-to-client — a fraction of a full node's resources. Portal 'maintainer pick'.
nodes.featuresText: REST/gRPC/JSON-RPC/Ouroboros APIs, 4-layer storage, Mini-Blockfrost

nodes.name: Scrolls
nodes.description: Read-optimized cache builder that map-reduces chain history into use-case-specific key-value collections. Development pace has slowed.
nodes.featuresText: Map-reduce aggregation, KV collections, plugins, GraphQL generation

nodes.name: Marconi
nodes.description: Customizable indexing library and ready-made indexers from IOG with SQLite/file/in-memory backends.
nodes.featuresText: Custom backends, EpochSDD/MintBurn indexers, db-sync correctness tests, HTTP API

nodes.name: Adder
nodes.description: Go streaming tool/library that tails the chain and emits block/transaction events through configurable filters.
nodes.featuresText: Block/tx events, NtC/NtN, JSON output, pipeline integration

nodes.name: Mumak
nodes.description: PostgreSQL extension for querying Cardano transaction CBOR directly with SQL functions.
nodes.featuresText: CBOR-in-SQL query functions, Postgres extension

nodes.name: Argus (Cardano.Sync)
nodes.description: .NET indexing framework where you define reducers to shape the data stored in PostgreSQL.
nodes.featuresText: Reducer-based indexing, PostgreSQL, .NET-native

nodes.name: cf-ledger-sync
nodes.description: Enterprise Java indexer syncing chain data into PostgreSQL with db-sync-level completeness; can stream to Kafka/RabbitMQ.
nodes.featuresText: db-sync-level data, Kafka/RabbitMQ streaming, high availability

nodes.name: Yaci Store
nodes.description: Modular Java indexer with pluggable stores, plugin-based filtering, Blockfrost-compatible REST and Parquet exports. Portal 'maintainer pick'.
nodes.featuresText: Pluggable stores, JS/Python/MVEL plugins, governance state, Blockfrost-compatible

nodes.name: pg_cardano
nodes.description: PostgreSQL extension providing Cardano cryptographic, address-encoding and CBOR helper functions.
nodes.featuresText: Crypto/address/CBOR SQL helpers, Postgres extension

nodes.name: cardano-node
nodes.description: The core node: validates the chain, produces blocks and serves the node-to-node and node-to-client protocols. The reference implementation.
nodes.featuresText: Ouroboros consensus, block production/validation, N2N & N2C protocols
nodes.usedBy: All network participants, SPOs, explorers, indexers

nodes.name: cardano-cli
nodes.description: Command-line tool for keys, addresses, transactions, stake-pool and governance operations against a local node.
nodes.featuresText: Key/address gen, tx build/sign/submit, pool ops, Conway governance, offline signing

nodes.name: Ogmios
nodes.description: Lightweight WebSocket/HTTP JSON-RPC bridge exposing a local node's mini-protocols through a language-agnostic API. Portal 'maintainer pick'.
nodes.featuresText: JSON-RPC 2.0 over WS/HTTP, chain-sync, tx submit, mempool, ledger-state queries
nodes.usedBy: Wallets, dApp backends, Kupo/Dolos, Mesh, CTL

nodes.name: gOuroboros
nodes.description: Go implementation of the Ouroboros protocol family — the foundation for Blink Labs' Go Cardano stack.
nodes.featuresText: N2N & N2C mini-protocols, block sync, UTxO queries, single binary

nodes.name: Cardano Node API
nodes.description: Exposes a local cardano-node over REST and gRPC (UTxO RPC) APIs.
nodes.featuresText: REST + gRPC (UTxO RPC), local node access

nodes.name: UTxORPC
nodes.description: A standardized gRPC interface specification for UTxO blockchains (Cardano, Bitcoin) with compact binary serialization and multi-language SDKs.
nodes.featuresText: Query/Submit/Sync/Watch modules, protobuf codegen (Go/Rust/Py/JS/C++/C#)

nodes.name: Dingo
nodes.description: Full Cardano node in Go with built-in indexing and Blockfrost/UTxO-RPC APIs. Actively developed; not yet production-ready for consensus.
nodes.featuresText: Built-in indexer, PlutusV1/V2/V3, Mithril bootstrap, pluggable storage, Rosetta

nodes.name: Amaru
nodes.description: Open-source Rust full-node implementation aiming to increase client diversity, running alongside the Haskell node; planned Leios support.
nodes.featuresText: Rust node, TxPipe P2P layer, Leios roadmap, multi-platform installers

nodes.name: cardano-submit-api
nodes.description: HTTP service accepting CBOR-encoded transactions and submitting them via the LocalTxSubmission protocol; a Go implementation also exists.
nodes.featuresText: HTTP tx submission, CBOR, container-ready

nodes.name: cardano-wallet
nodes.description: HTTP server + CLI for HD wallet management and UTxOs (backs Daedalus). In maintenance-only mode since April 2025 — bug fixes, no new features.
nodes.featuresText: HD wallets, coin selection, tx build/submit, delegation, REST API

nodes.name: Hydra
nodes.description: Layer-2 scaling via isomorphic state channels (Hydra Heads) that move transactions off-chain for near-instant, low-cost finality.
nodes.featuresText: Hydra Heads, off-chain mini-ledger, mainnet-capable, hydra-node, monthly updates

nodes.name: Mithril
nodes.description: Stake-based multi-signature protocol producing certified snapshots for fast node bootstrapping and lightweight chain certification.
nodes.featuresText: Threshold multi-sigs, certified snapshots, fast bootstrap, light-client certification
nodes.usedBy: Light/mobile wallets, SPOs, L2, Dingo bootstrap

nodes.name: Midgard
nodes.description: Cardano's first permissionless optimistic rollup L2, targeting ~300x throughput while preserving the EUTxO model and fraud-proof validation.
nodes.featuresText: Optimistic rollup, permissionless, EUTxO-preserving, Aiken/Plutus redeploy

nodes.name: Hydra Pay
nodes.description: Open-source library making it easier to use Hydra Heads for payment processing and channel management.
nodes.featuresText: Payment channels over Hydra, developer API

nodes.name: Balius
nodes.description: Framework and building blocks for headless Cardano dApps — foundational tooling for off-chain business logic.
nodes.featuresText: Headless dApp framework, tx building, modular
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: Midnight
nodes.description: Privacy-focused partner chain (data-protection sidechain) using zero-knowledge proofs, with native interoperability to Cardano.
nodes.featuresText: ZK selective privacy, native Cardano interop, NIGHT/DUST tokens, Compact language
nodes.statusReason: hosted / no GitHub repo — status not auto-derived

nodes.name: Partner Chains

nodes.featuresText: Native interop, inherited security, shared liquidity, composable services

nodes.featuresText: ConnectWalletButton/List, useCardano hook, CIP-30/45/8/95, mobile deep links
